name: telephonepole
short: Dynamically registers third-party MCP servers for registered A2A agents.
description: Lets a bot owner register/unregister external MCP tools servers at runtime, making their tools available to a registered A2A agent's own tool loop, gated per server and per agent -- the same corridor AgentToolServerRegistry pattern suggestionbox uses for its own in-process server, generalized to any third-party MCP endpoint.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no data about Discord users: only bot-owner-registered third-party MCP server names/URLs and a per-server, per-agent access list. Tool calls LLM agents make to those servers (which can include conversation content) are sent to them and not stored by the cog.
install_msg: Install corridor too ([p]cog install pixel-agents-cogs corridor); it loads automatically. Outside services: connects to the third-party MCP servers you register, and the agents you grant access send tool-call arguments to them. Setup (bot owner): [p]telephonepole add <name> <url>, then [p]telephonepole agents <name>.
author: Pixel Agents HQ Contributors
